sections.title: Market Pulse: AI Fears and Oil Prices Drive Downward Trend

items.headline: U.S. Stocks Retreat as AI Concerns and Elevated Oil Prices Weigh on Sentiment
items.summary: U.S. equities experienced a downturn on Monday, with major indices closing lower. Investor sentiment was primarily impacted by renewed concerns regarding the pace of AI development, surging crude oil prices, and anticipation of a potential Federal Reserve interest rate hike later this week. Defensive sectors saw some shelter, while technology and chipmakers faced significant selling pressure.

items.headline: RUM Group Soars on Anthropic Computing Contract
items.summary: RUM Group shares jumped 22% following reports that Anthropic agreed to a significant $13.7 billion computing contract with the company.

items.headline: SentinelOne Rallies Amidst Cybersecurity Strength
items.summary: Cybersecurity firm SentinelOne ($S) gained 16.23% during the session. The software sector, particularly cybersecurity names, demonstrated strength.

items.headline: Zscaler Sees Strong Gains
items.summary: Cloud security company Zscaler Inc. ($ZS) advanced 15.85% today. Software and cybersecurity stocks showed notable positive movement.

items.headline: Nvidia Tumbles on AI Slowdown Fears
items.summary: Shares of chipmaker Nvidia ($NVDA) fell 2.8% to $212.07, hitting a near three-week low. The decline was attributed to top U.S. executives, including Anthropic's CEO, raising safety concerns and advocating for a slowdown in AI development.

items.headline: Marvell Technology Drops Amid AI Concerns
items.summary: Marvell Technology ($MRVL) saw its stock decline by 6%. Chipmakers were broadly impacted by the ongoing discussions around an AI development slowdown.

items.headline: Corning Inc. Experiences Significant Pullback
items.summary: Corning Inc. ($GLW) dropped 12.87% during Monday's trading session, listed among the large-cap stock movers.

items.headline: Defensive Sectors Lead as Tech and Industrials Lag
items.summary: On Monday, defensive sectors like Consumer Staples (XLP +1.16%) and Health Care (XLV +1.17%) showed resilience. In contrast, Information Technology (XLK -2.44%) and Industrials (XLI -1.55%) were among the worst performers, reflecting a rotation out of growth-oriented segments.

items.headline: Anticipation Builds for Mid-Week Fed Rate Decision
items.summary: The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) is set to meet this week, with an interest rate decision expected on Wednesday, September 16. Markets are widely pricing in an 85% to 90% probability of a 25-basis-point rate hike, driven by August's sticky inflation data and a tight labor market. This would mark the first rate increase since 2023.

items.headline: AI Slowdown Concerns Shake Semiconductor Stocks
items.summary: Top AI executives, including Anthropic's Dario Amodei, Elon Musk, and OpenAI's Sam Altman, voiced concerns over the rapid pace of AI development, suggesting a slowdown. This sparked a selloff in major AI and chip stocks like Nvidia ($NVDA) and AMD ($AMD), impacting the broader technology sector.

items.headline: Crude Oil Prices Surge Amid Geopolitical Tensions
items.summary: Brent crude approached $108 a barrel, and WTI crude rose above $103, as escalating Middle East tensions and key pipeline shutdowns fueled concerns about supply. Rising energy costs contributed to inflationary pressures and cautious market sentiment.

items.headline: American Battery Technology Reports Strong FY26 Results
items.summary: American Battery Technology Company ($ABAT) held its Q4 2026 earnings conference call today, reporting record FY 2026 revenue and positive adjusted gross margin. Other companies like Hain Celestial ($HAIN) and RF Industries ($RFIL) also had earnings reports scheduled.
